validate_trace_format: validate a Chrome trace JSON file for type violations and missing arguments at a given level
run_validate_trace_cli: run the validate_trace CLI to check a trace file against minimal standard or complete validation levels
get_argument_spec: get the list of attribute specs for a given validation level like minimal standard or complete
get_expected_arguments: convert a list of attribute specs into a pandas DataFrame with argument keys types and defaults
check_args: check a dictionary of trace event arguments against expected value types and report violations or skipped keys
